instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST build all views with .jsx / .js React standard inside src/components/ or src/views/.
Implement clean tabbed or route-based navigation driven by state or react-router.
Include pre-loaded rich demo datasets for 3 verticals: EV (Tesla, Rivian, Lucid), SaaS (Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic), Consumer Electronics (Apple, Sony, Bose).
Ensure every single interactive element has a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Do NOT rely on full transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, popovers, or modals. Use backdrop blur with dark slate background fill.
Render the 2-axis positioning map cleanly using Recharts ScatterChart or custom Interactive SVG Canvas.
Provide a working AI analysis simulation with progress indicators (Website Crawling -> Extracting Pricing -> GPT-5.4 Feature Mapping -> SWOT Synthesis -> Score Calculation).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look best when layered with solid slate surfaces (#1F2937, #111827) and crisp 1px borders (#374151). Avoid heavy gradients.
Never center-align the whole dashboard page container.
Use micro-animations on interactive badges, action toggles (P0/P1/P2), and chart hover states.
Ensure generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside card containers to prevent text collisions.
Maintain strict APCA/WCAG readability: text-slate-100 for titles, text-slate-300 for body, text-slate-400 for subtext.
